notes: Converted from Spearman rho: cytokines (IL-6 IL-8 IL-10 IL-12) vs processing speed domain; rho=0.18-0.40 range; midpoint rho=0.29; d=2r/sqrt(1-r^2)=-0.606; SE=sqrt(4/N+d^2/2N)=0.108; N=362 CRC patients (289 localized + 73 metastatic); bivariate unadjusted; NOTE: global cognition (GDS) showed NO association with cytokines — processing speed was the only domain with significant cytokine association; upstream_instrument is TMT as proxy — actual measure was domain T-score composite
extraction_snippet: Some cytokines (especially interleukin [IL] -6 IL-8 IL-10 and IL-12) were associated with reduced information-processing speed (rho = 0.18 to 0.40). No significant association was found between global cognitive function (clinical GDS CANTAB GDS) and hemoglobin liver function tests clotting factors or cytokines.
